Beta candidate. Quick test, faults, readings, live data, guided tests and experimental service functions.

**New in 0.99.39:**
- **30 more models, so your badge is in the list.** All-wheel-drive cars now have their own entries (E90 330xi, 328i xDrive; 5 Series 525xi, 530xi, 528xi, 535xi and the later xDrive names), and so do the E46 coupes and convertibles (323Ci, 328Ci, 325Ci, 330Ci), the 6 Series (630i, 650i, 635d, M6), the X6 M and the X6 diesels. Also new: E46 320i and Compact, 1 Series 125i and 130i, 5 Series 523i, 540i, 525d and 530d, X5 xDrive30d and 40d, X1 20i, E39 520i, 523i, 530i and 535i, Z4 2.2i and 2.5i, and the E38 740d. Grouped names now list every badge they cover (for example 316i / 318i / 320i). 114 models in all.
- **Each new model uses the data of the model with the same engine.** Its fault meanings, tests and module list come from the existing model it shares an engine with; all-wheel-drive cars also list the transfer case module.

**Downloads:** unzip and run Klemme15 (Klemme15.exe on Windows). The command-line tool is in the cli folder. EDIABAS mode (your own BMW files) is included in every build.

Earlier versions: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/Expos-AI/Klemme15/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).
